svg.text: Inventory Management System (Strategy and Factory patterns, validation rules shown as {constraints})
Types are language-independent: "Product [0..*]" = a collection of Product, "Product [0..1]" = a Product or nothing (None).
Uses Inventory, Supplier and ProductFactory to save/load inventory.json (dependency only).
− private + public italic = abstract underline = static
Unknown product_type raises ValueError. Only the factory
Strategy pattern: Order only calls apply(). A new discount is a new subclass of DiscountStrategy; Order does not change.
